summary: Change a text layer's content or style

params.title: pixelox text.edit parameters
params.description: Change a text layer's content or style

input.description: Input file: an image, PSD, SVG, or .pxo document

output.description: Output path (-o); format from the extension

in_place.description: Mutate the input .pxo document instead of writing -o

layer.description: Text layer: name, #N (1 = top), @top, @bottom, or @active; defaults to the only text layer Type: layer.

content.description: New text; \n in the value starts a new paragraph Type: text.

font.description: Font family (case-insensitive), a class such as @condensed-heavy or @didone (`pixelox fonts classes`), or a generic name: sans-serif, serif, monospace; a missing family is replaced by the closest installed face of its class (warning PXW4010) Type: text.

size.description: Font size: 48pt (points at the document DPI), 64px, a bare number of px, or % of the canvas height Type: length.

weight.description: Weight 100..900 or a name (thin, light, normal, medium, semibold, bold, extrabold, black); default 400, or the class's own weight with --font @class Type: text.

style.description: Upright or italic; a missing italic face is slanted synthetically Type: choice.

stretch.description: Width: ultra-condensed, extra-condensed, condensed, semi-condensed, normal, semi-expanded, expanded (extended), ... or 50%..200%; picks the face of that width (a weight never changes the width) or sets a variable font's wdth axis Type: text.

variation.description: Variable-font axis values, e.g. 'wght=650,slnt=-5' (none clears them) Type: text.

color.description: Fill color of the glyphs Type: color.

stroke.description: Outline color, centered on the glyph edges (transparent removes it) Type: color.

stroke_width.description: Outline width: px, pt, or % of the font size Type: length.

align.description: Line alignment inside the text box; justify stretches all but each paragraph's last line Type: choice.

tracking.description: Letter spacing in 1/1000 em (60 = 0.06 em); nonzero tracking turns ligatures off Range: -1000..10000. Type: number.

leading.description: Line spacing: auto (the font's line height), px or pt, or % of the font size (120%) Type: length.

kerning.description: metrics applies the font's kerning; none turns it off Type: choice.

case.description: Set the text in upper, lower, or title case (the content keeps what was typed); none sets it as typed Type: choice.

scale_x.description: Horizontal scale of the letters and their spacing (Photoshop's character scaling): 80% or 0.8; the text stays live Type: length.

scale_y.description: Vertical scale of the set text: 120% or 1.2; the text stays live Type: length.

faux_bold.description: Thicken every stem by this much, in 1/1000 em (20 is about one weight step; 0 removes it) Range: 0..300. Type: number.

fit_width.description: Size the type so its visible letters span exactly this width (px, or % of the canvas width); the fit is redone when the text changes; 0 removes it Type: length.

fit_box.description: Size the type as large as fits inside WxH (px or % of the canvas), measured on the visible letters; 0x0 removes it Type: WxH.

warp.description: Warp the glyph outlines (they stay vector and editable): arc, arc-lower, arc-upper, arch, bulge, shell-lower, shell-upper, flag, wave, fish, rise, fisheye, inflate, squeeze, twist; none removes it Type: choice.

bend.description: Warp strength in % (default 50; negative bends the other way) Range: -100..100. Type: number.

h_distort.description: Warp horizontal distortion in %: a perspective that grows the right side (negative: the left) Range: -100..100. Type: number.

v_distort.description: Warp vertical distortion in %: a perspective that grows the bottom (negative: the top) Range: -100..100. Type: number.

orient.description: Apply the warp along the horizontal (default) or vertical axis Type: choice.

strict_font.description: Fail when the font is not installed (PX4102, or PX1540 when it can be downloaded) instead of substituting; PIXELOX_STRICT_FONTS=1 does the same Type: flag.

at.description: Anchor point on the canvas: X,Y in px, %, pt, mm, or in; negative values count from the far edge Type: X,Y.

anchor.description: Which point of the text box sits at --at: tl t tr l c r bl b br Type: choice.

box.description: Paragraph box WxH (px or % of the canvas): lines wrap at its width; the height is reported if exceeded Type: WxH.

anchor_to.description: box: --at/--anchor place the text box (default); ink: they place the visible letters, so --at 80,90 --anchor tl puts the top-left of the letters exactly there Type: choice.

result.description: Command-specific; doc ops include op, params, and document. Dry runs include plan.
